load_GHN1: load a pretrained GHN-1 Graph HyperNetwork model for ImageNet or CIFAR-10
load_GHN2: load a pretrained GHN-2 Graph HyperNetwork model for ImageNet or CIFAR-10
load_GHN_checkpoint: load a GHN model from an arbitrary checkpoint file using GHN.load
predict_GHN_forward: predict neural network parameters by passing a network through GHN forward pass
parallelize_ghn: wrap a GHN model in DataParallel for multi-GPU training using ghn_parallel
